content: seeds-a77c HITL pilot: human gates live in the CONDUCTOR parent only (develop children run args.auto_approve=true and would self-answer gates with the first option). Gate node DSL in workflow.fabro: shape=hexagon, human.question, human.options ('skip:[S] ... | park:[P] ...'), human.freeform, human.default_choice, timeout_seconds; gate outcome edges condition on human.choice/human.freeform and must be kind=soft (FAIL-CLOSED: pending gate blocks the run, timeout default skip self-heals). Routing-label contract: every new preferred_next_label needs BOTH the node's outgoing edge (preferred_label condition) AND the output-schema enum — structural check compares enum vs preferred_label-conditioned edges (unconditional default edges like 'Seed claimed' and 'Unrouted ...' safety nets are outside the enum contract). Node-attr regex checks must not use [^]]* when human.options contains literal [S]/[P].

description: v0.361 (deployed on the mirtuell fabro container): `fabro server status` inside a container whose ps is BusyBox DELETES /storage/server.json — ServerDaemon::load_running() treats a failed liveness probe as stale and removes the record, and server_process_matches shells `ps -ww -o command= -p <pid>` which BusyBox does not support, so the probe ALWAYS fails there. Symptom: API/UI healthy but every run spawn dies launch_failed with 'server record /storage/server.json is missing' (evidence: run 01M382SX36Q6WSZN1ZWX1KQCKT, 2026-09-23 21:30 UTC; earlier passes spawned fine until a status call reaped the file).
resolution: Recovery: rewrite the descriptor JSON by hand (in-container pid of `fabro server start --foreground`, bind tcp 0.0.0.0:32276, log_path /storage/logs/server.log, started_at; owner = server uid, mode 600) — the spawn path (server.rs self_server_target) uses plain ServerDaemon::read(), no liveness check, so spawning recovers without restart. Never run `fabro server status` in that container until the ps-probe is fixed upstream (fabro bug candidate: make load_running non-destructive or the probe BusyBox-safe).

name: env-pin-toolchain-is-fabro-only
description: fabro env pin-toolchain (fabro-4f44) pins ONLY env id 'toolchain' with repo ghcr.io/denkhaus/fabro-toolchain and fail-closed-compares the tag sha12 against the deployed server git_sha (GET /api/v1/system/info). It CANNOT pin seeds-toolchain. For other toolchain envs use: fabro env --server <url> update seeds-toolchain --image ghcr.io/denkhaus/seeds-toolchain:<sha12>. Note --server is a group-level flag: it goes after the group word (fabro env --server X update ...), not at the end. Evidence: 2026-09-24 cutover, seeds-7fcb runbook step 3 failed with 'deployed-server/tag mismatch: server is built from , tag is 4728193e1106' — the mirtuell server reports an EMPTY git_sha, so the parity gate can never pass against it (fabro-bug candidate: system info git_sha empty on restored-server.json deployment).
